records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in revenue was primarily driven by higher volume in IET on Gas Technology Equipment project backlog execution and better activity in OFSE.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Within IET, Gas Technology orders were $1.9 billion and $2.4 billion, Industrial Technology orders were $0.8 billion and $0.9 billion, and Climate Technology Solutions ("CTS") orders were $0.2 billion and $0.3 billion, for the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the first quarter of 2024, the Company generated revenue of $6,418 million, compared to $5,716 million in the first quarter of 2023, increasing $702 million or 12%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in income before tax was driven primarily by the decrease of positive effect from the change in fair value on certain equity securities compared to the first quarter of 2023, partially offset higher volume and price in both segments and structural cost-out initiatives.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total segment operating income increased $139 million, driven by both segments.
